index.title: Reports
index.subtitle: What was billed, what it earned, and what is still owed to you.
index.basis: These figures come from invoiced work and the frozen snapshot each invoice used — never from a recalculation. A closed period always says the same thing, and a load that has been delivered but not invoiced does not appear here yet.

aging.title: Receivables ageing
aging.note: Open invoices by how long they have been due. Balances come from the payments recorded against each invoice.
